name: godot_profiler
description: Performance profiling and analysis: snapshot all engine metrics, collect per-frame time series data with spike detection, list active _process/_physics_process scripts, inspect signal connections

action.description:
snapshot: Full performance snapshot (all engine metrics)
start: Start per-frame time-series profiling
stop: Stop time-series profiling
get_data: Get collected time-series data with spike detection
get_active_processes: List active _process/_physics_process scripts
get_signal_connections: Inspect signal connections

node_path.description: Node path (defaults to scene root) (for: get_signal_connections)
